key.name: show-in-quick-settings
key.description: Display the screen blank delay menu in GNOME Quick Settings

key.name: show-in-top-bar
key.description: Display an indicator in the GNOME Shell top panel

key.name: top-bar-display-style
key.description: Display style for the top bar indicator: 'compact' (e.g. 10m), 'full' (e.g. 10 min), or 'icon-only'

key.name: per-monitor-enabled
key.description: Allow configuring individual blank delays for each connected monitor

key.name: per-monitor-delays
key.description: Dictionary mapping monitor connector/name to delay in seconds (-1 for follow system, 0 for never)

key.name: wake-on-pointer-move
key.description: Wake a blanked monitor as soon as the mouse cursor enters it

key.name: fade-animation
key.description: Fade screens smoothly when blanking or waking

key.name: last-active-system-delay
key.description: Saved idle delay in seconds before screen blank was set to Never
